headline: Vipul Patel appointed as Managing Director of Ice Make Refrigeration
hook: Leadership transition at Ice Make Refrigeration
summary: Ice Make Refrigeration Limited has announced the appointment of Vipul Patel as the Managing Director of the company, effective September 5, 2026. Management changes at small-cap listed entities can signal shifts in strategic direction or operational focus. Retail investors tracking corporate governance and leadership changes in the cooling solutions sector should note this upcoming transition.
why_it_matters: New leadership takes charge at Ice Make Refrigeration in 2026.
